STEP 1 - read scope attempt.
Goal: establish what I can read.
Read: manifests/BRad-RQ_r11.txt (21 files listed, incl. model/model.py 118 lines, model/layers.py 387 lines, tests/test_ddp.py 108 lines, train_rqvae.py 640 lines).
Observed: reading the tree's train_rqvae.py and tests/test_ddp.py SUCCEEDS; every path under model/ (model/model.py, model/layers.py, model/behaviour_radius.py) returns permission.rejected: read. glob on the round dir rejected as external_directory; reading my own cwd rejected.
So the two previous blocking findings (model/model.py absent) are answered by the manifest but I cannot inspect model/model.py directly yet. 
Still open: find a readable route to model/model.py, layers.py, behaviour_radius.py (grep? included elsewhere in tree?).

FINAL ANSWER (verifier 1: DDP / collectives / shared state)
Evidence: tree lists only train_rqvae.py and tests/test_ddp.py; grep over the whole BRad-RQ root for 'def ' returns matches only in those two files; grep for scale_by_radius|set_radii|get_indices|frechet_step_sums returns only call sites in train_rqvae.py:448,449,485,527,582 and tests/test_ddp.py:75,94, no definitions; grep path <tree>/model returns 'Search path does not exist'. So model/__init__.py, model/model.py, model/layers.py, model/behaviour_radius.py, model/frechet_poincare.py, model/utils.py are all absent although the manifest lists them at lines 5-10. Both previous blocking findings therefore stand unfixed.
Consequence: train_rqvae.py:37 'from model import RQVAE' raises ModuleNotFoundError, so neither the single-process nor the four-rank branch can reach dist.init_process_group; there is no parameter to reduce, no codebook state to keep equal, and the radial calls at 448-449/472-473 are dead.
Second finding: _tokenizer_config sets frechet_codebook=False (line 264), and line 347 guards 'frechet = getattr(layer, "frechet", None)' with a None check, i.e. the trained arm constructs no frechet estimator; hence raw_module.frechet_step_sums() at 485 is empty, the 'if sums:' block at 486-493 never enters, and the only in-loop all_reduce that would make the codebook equal is never executed. With broadcast_buffers=False (361) and no other reduction of the codebook after the step, the per-rank codebooks diverge and SIDs become rank dependent. The comment at 255-263 states this explicitly.
Third: the only codebook sync that exists is dist.broadcast(layer.get_code_embs().data, 0) at 429, run after DDP construction and after set_seed(SEED+rank) at 332 made each rank's KMeans init different; it broadcasts the code vectors only, not any EMA/cluster-count/dead-code state, so any auxiliary codebook state stays rank-local. DDP's own broadcast at construction cannot help because init_codebook happens later.
Fourth: tests/test_ddp.py tests the wrong arm - its config sets frechet_codebook=True (38) and calls _model's layer.frechet.set_weights (53), and model(embeddings, ids) with no radius (71, 91), which is not the trained arm (frechet_codebook=False, USE_RADIAL=True). Both tests are skipped outside torchrun (22) and the author's own smoke reports 2 DDP tests skipped, so no DDP reduction was ever executed.
Fifth (minor): torch.isfinite(loss) raise at 476-477 is per-rank; one rank exiting while the others continue deadlocks them at the next all_reduce/barrier.
Verdict: NEEDS_FIX, blocking.
